title: Green Car Future - The BMW i3 Auxiliary Cabin Heating System (What You Need To Know), Tristan Perry, 2021-05-24
notes: Says that in the US all i3 units made before the 2019 model year had the heat pump as standard and that from 2019 it was optional; the i3 REx never had one. Owner-side blog, not BMW. Says no i3 REx had a heat pump; BMW US 2016 and 2017 pricing guides list it as standard on the REx too.
